name: Hand-Drawn Hardship Cartoon
description: An expressive animal illustration language using uneven ink, limited flat color, and sparse annotated paper-like space.
style_bible: Draw with uneven black ink contours, flat limited fills, and sparse paper-like backgrounds. Make anatomically coherent animals expressive, with clear eyes, limbs, posture, and species-defining details. Use a tactile hand-drawn annotation texture only where the selected thumbnail recipe asks for it; keep one readable focal animal and avoid crowding the frame. Favor warm moss, muted leaf green, cream, charcoal, faded gold, and quiet water or earth tones over glossy dramatic lighting.
negative_prompt: Reject photoreal stock imagery, glossy CGI, copied channel branding, duplicate captions, watermarks/logos, violent cruelty, malformed anatomy, malformed text, dense collage, cluttered labels, neon colors, and copied trade dress.
